description: smooth-motion.md gates 3 and 4: one ARMCOM walking a PATROL under a pinned camera, with the order carried by the scenario so the run is reproducible tick for tick. It has to be a patrol and not a list of moves: ORDERS_NewMainOrder2Unit (0x43AFC0) replaces the main order rather than queueing it, and it drops an order whose target is within +/-16 wu of the standing one (the tolerance test at 0x43B006), so a six-leg move list collapses to its last leg -- which, being the start point, is a no-op and the unit never takes a step. One patrol walks the leg and turns round, forever. The gate-C fixture (walk-gatec) leaves the orders to the shell, which lands them on whatever tick the wire delivers them on and puts two runs several ticks out of phase -- fine for a flicker detector, useless for diffing a COB trace. Keepalive: a slot owning nothing is a defeat, so CORE holds one unit far outside the camera band; shootall off so it never fights.
